resources.string: Shows your active chanting session progress
A distraction-free digital mala for your spiritual practice
Allows volume buttons to count chants without changing volume

SuperChant uses this accessibility service to detect volume button presses during your chanting session.

When enabled, pressing volume up or down will increment your count instead of changing the volume.

This service only activates when you start a chanting session and has no access to your screen content or other apps.
To count chants with volume buttons, SuperChant needs accessibility permission.\n\nThis allows the app to detect button presses without changing your volume.

1. Tap "Open Settings" below
2. Find "SuperChant Volume Counter"
3. Toggle it ON
4. Return to the app
Please enable the accessibility service to start counting
Since this app was installed outside the Play Store, you may need to allow restricted settings before enabling accessibility.
Open App Info, look for \"Allow restricted settings\" in the menu or under permissions, enable it, then return here.
Find \"SuperChant Volume Counter\" in the list and turn it ON
